invariants.rationale: A non-null instantTime is typically required to identify the commit point for delete operations.
The list of HoodieKey objects to delete should be provided (non-null) for delete to perform its function.
A valid HoodieEngineContext is typically required for distributed processing in Hudi operations.
Delete is usually only meaningful if there is at least one key in the list to operate on.
A non-empty instantTime string is usually required to specify a valid commit or action instant.
